summary: Capstone Companies filed an 8-K/A amending a prior 8-K to modify a Letter of Intent with eBliss Global. The amendment extends the superior proposal provision in a March 2026 promissory note to the LOI's no-shop provision and corrects the no-shop expiration date to July 31, 2026. No deal terms, price, or premium were disclosed. The filing indicates preliminary discussions, not a definitive agreement. Watch for a potential acquisition or partnership; risk-arb not applicable at this stage.
